answer: Stake-bond slashing at the quill: each identity must lock collateral ≥ 30 days of expected yield. Nectar accrues only to slashed-and-verified nodes, so fake identities earn zero. A farm creating n identities risks n×bond; one detected duplicate burns 100% of collateral plus 20% penalty. The oasis of honest yield shrinks as n grows. Below 5 identities, break-even; beyond, losses compound. Slashing converts sybil cost from linear to punitive, making identity farming economically irrational.
